messages:
Olga (Finance): Heads-up — Northspan flagged two March invoices: one shows $0 for usage lines, the other is a duplicate with full total. They attached PDFs and say accounting can't reconcile. Can someone take?
billing-bot: Alert: invoice_anomaly_count=2 customer_id=northspan_inc run_id=monthly_run_2026_03_15 severity=medium
Maya (Support): Ticket #5599 created: https://support.redwood.ai/t/5599 — customer attached both PDFs, says one has an extra 'promo_adjustment' line that shouldn't apply.
Jordan (Billing Eng): Can you paste invoice IDs?
Olga (Finance): PDFs show invoice IDs 2026-04-15007 and 2026-04-15007-b. The b invoice total = $28,400, the first invoice total = $0.
Jordan (Billing Eng): Querying invoices table: 
```sql
select invoice_id, status, total_cents, captures, created_by, batch_run
from invoices where customer_id='northspan_inc' and invoice_id like '2026-04-15007%';
```
Jordan (Billing Eng): Returned: 2026-04-15007 total_cents=0 captures=0 batch_run=monthly_run_2026_03_15; 2026-04-15007-b total_cents=2840000 captures=1 batch_run=monthly_run_2026_03_15.
Ethan (Payments): Capture was only on the -b invoice; payment gateway shows one capture for $28,400 (charge_id ch_7n1). No refunds yet.
Priya (Product): We rolled a pricing experiment flag for promo_adjustment to 10% for a subset. Could this have caused duplication? The experiment toggles a post-process that patches line items.
Jordan (Billing Eng): Possible race between invoice_writer and promo_patch job. If promo_patch runs while invoice_writer is mid-commit, we might have created a partial invoice and then patched another copy. I want to inspect the line_items table.
Jordan (Billing Eng): Quick check: 
```sql
select invoice_id, count(*) as li_count, sum(amount_cents) as sum_cents
from invoice_line_items where invoice_id in ('2026-04-15007','2026-04-15007-b') group by invoice_id;
```
Jordan (Billing Eng): Results: 2026-04-15007 li_count=2 sum_cents=0; 2026-04-15007-b li_count=11 sum_cents=2840000.
Maya (Support): Customer asks: will you void the zero invoice and issue a corrected PDF with explanation? Also wants confirmation credit/refund will appear before month-end close.
Olga (Finance): If capture only on -b then we should void the zero invoice and keep -b as canonical. We'll issue a credit note for the promo line if needed. Priority: corrected PDF + reconciliation note.
Jordan (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) mark 2026-04-15007 status=void (preserve audit) 2) attach audit_note to 2026-04-15007-b and regenerate PDF 3) create credit memo if any overcharge due to promo mispatch 4) write follow-up fix: make promo_patch job idempotent and add a lock on invoice_writer for batch_run.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: billing/patches add-locks and idempotent-promo-patch -> staging
Ethan (Payments): If refund needed, I can trigger immediate refund once finance signs off. For now capture stands.
Priya (Product): I'll pause the experiment rollout and revert the promo flag while we investigate.
Jordan (Billing Eng): Executing void script: `./ops/void_invoice.sh 2026-04-15007 --reason "duplicate/incomplete generation" --actor jordan`
billing-bot: Task update: void_invoice job success invoice=2026-04-15007 actor=jordan ts=1850127850
Jordan (Billing Eng): Regenerated canonical PDF for 2026-04-15007-b and uploaded to ticket. Added audit line: "Canonical invoice retained; duplicate incomplete invoice voided (batch monthly_run_2026_03_15)."
Maya (Support): Sent PDFs to Northspan and noted we'll issue a credit memo if needed. Customer replied: "Please confirm the ledger/tax lines match — our accounting requires VAT lines present."
Olga (Finance): VAT lines were missing on the zero invoice only. The canonical invoice has VAT. We'll include reconciliation csv and ledger entries.
Jordan (Billing Eng): Backfill executed to ensure line_items table matches PDF: `python scripts/backfill_invoice_lines.py --invoice 2026-04-15007-b --source batch_ledger` — completed.
billing-bot: Job update: backfill_invoice_lines completed invoice=2026-04-15007-b status=success ts=1850127955
Ethan (Payments): No refund required, but we'll issue a credit memo for the promo over-apply. Finance — please approve credit and I'll process memo.
Olga (Finance): Approved. Creating credit memo CM-2026-04-0157 and linking to the account. We'll post it against next statement and notify customer.
Priya (Product): PR opened to add distributed lock around invoice_writer and to make promo_patch idempotent: https://git.redwood.ai/r/billing/+/pr/325
Jordan (Billing Eng): Deployed lock to staging, smoke tests pass. Will schedule prod deploy after 6pm PST change window.
Maya (Support): Northspan says thanks, asks for short RCA and timeline for permanent fix. I'll tell them we expect prod fix tonight and will send RCA tomorrow.
Olga (Finance): Thanks everyone. Please paste the final ledger confirmation here once the credit memo is posted.
Jordan (Billing Eng): Credit memo posted and ledger reconciled. Note: "credit CM-2026-04-0157 applied to northspan_inc for promo overapply; duplicate invoice voided."
Olga (Finance): Closing — I'll update the support ticket and attach the RCA when ready. :white_check_mark:
